use default

union Token(text: string) is
    NUMBER(..)
    OPERATOR(..)
    OPEN(..)
    CLOSE(..)
si

scan(line: string) -> Pipe[Token] is
    for word in line.split([' ']) do
        case word
        when "(" then yield Token.OPEN(word)
        when ")" then yield Token.CLOSE(word)
        when "^", "*", "/", "+", "-" then yield Token.OPERATOR(word)
        else yield Token.NUMBER(word)
        esac
    od
si

precedence(symbol: string) -> int =>
    case symbol
    when "^" then 4
    when "*", "/" then 3
    else 2
    esac

binds_tighter(top: string, incoming: string) -> bool =>
    precedence(top) > precedence(incoming) \/
    (precedence(top) == precedence(incoming) /\ incoming !~ "^")

show(tokens: List[Token]) -> string =>
    tokens |> map(token => token.text) |> join(" ")

row(token: string, action: string, operators: string, output: string)
    -> string
=>
    "{token,-7}{action,-38}{operators,-14}{output}"

let line = "3 + 4 * 2 / ( 1 - 5 ) ^ 2 ^ 3"

let operators = LIST[Token]()
let output = LIST[Token]()

write_line(row("token", "action", "stack", "output"))

for token in scan(line) do
    let action mut = ""

    if let number: Token.NUMBER = token then
        output.add(number)

        action = "add to output"
    elif let operator: Token.OPERATOR = token then
        while
            operators.count > 0 /\
            isa Token.OPERATOR(operators[operators.count - 1]) /\
            binds_tighter(operators[operators.count - 1].text, operator.text)
        do
            output.add(operators[operators.count - 1])
            operators.remove_at(operators.count - 1)

            action = "pop to output, push operator"
        od

        operators.add(operator)

        if action.length == 0 then
            action = "push operator"
        fi
    elif isa Token.OPEN(token) then
        operators.add(token)

        action = "push open parenthesis"
    else
        while !isa Token.OPEN(operators[operators.count - 1]) do
            output.add(operators[operators.count - 1])
            operators.remove_at(operators.count - 1)
        od

        operators.remove_at(operators.count - 1)

        action = "pop to output until open parenthesis"
    fi

    write_line(row(token.text, action, show(operators), show(output)))
od

while operators.count > 0 do
    output.add(operators[operators.count - 1])
    operators.remove_at(operators.count - 1)

    write_line(
        row("", "pop remaining to output", show(operators), show(output)))
od

write_line("")
write_line(show(output))
